descriptions.value: In multiple functions in multiple locations, there is a possible background activity launch bypass due to a confused deputy. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

The Greenshift  WordPress plugin before 13.2.0 does not properly escape a block animation attribute before outputting it within an HTML attribute, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to inject arbitrary web scripts that execute when the content is viewed.

assertions.title: Greenshift < 13.2.0 - Contributor+ Stored XSS via Block Animation customProps Attribute
